"""Generate the verified fixed-instance carton recycling trajectory."""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_robolab import Session, PrimitiveError, quat_to_mat

OUT = Path('/app/output')
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
s = Session('recycle_carton', instance='/app/instance.json')
p = s.primitives()
s.record_start()

qm = p['top_down_quat'](.712)
p['move_ee']([.362, .314, .30], qm, speed=.18)
# The compliant descent stops against the carton at about z=.122.
# Preserve all 240 recorded approach steps before closing the fingers.
try:
    p['move_ee']([.363, .315, .105], qm, speed=.10, settle=5)
except PrimitiveError:
    pass
p['close_gripper'](25)
p['move_ee']([.38, .325, .38], qm, speed=.10, settle=5)
# At full extension the tracking error settles just outside the default
# tolerance; preserve the complete approach before the vertical descent.
try:
    p['move_ee']([.66, .10, .38], qm, speed=.13, settle=5)
except PrimitiveError:
    pass
p['move_ee']([.66, .10, .235], qm, speed=.10, settle=5)
p['open_gripper'](20)
p['move_ee']([.66, .10, .39], qm, speed=.13)

pos, q = p['get_object_pose']('orange_juice_carton')
R = quat_to_mat(q)
jo = pos + R @ np.array([0, 0, -.13])
qj = p['top_down_quat'](p['yaw_for_closing_dir'](R[:2, 0]))
p['move_ee']([jo[0], jo[1], .30], qj, speed=.16)
p['move_ee']([jo[0], jo[1], .023], qj, speed=.10, settle=5)
p['close_gripper'](25)
p['move_ee']([jo[0], jo[1], .32], qj, speed=.10, settle=5)
p['move_ee']([.67, -.10, .32], qj, speed=.13, tol=.01, settle=5)
p['move_ee']([.67, -.10, .17], qj, speed=.10, tol=.01, settle=5)
p['open_gripper'](25)
p['move_ee']([.67, -.10, .38], qj, speed=.13, tol=.01)
p['hold'](30)

actions = s.record_stop()
s.save_trajectory(actions, str(OUT / 'trajectory.npz'))
print(s.status(), flush=True)
assert s.status()['success']
